newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Clifton, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Clifton, N.J..

text.p: The Board of Education of the
City of Clifton in the County of Passaic
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Board Secretary of the Board of Education at the Administrative Offices of the Board of Education, 745 Clifton Avenue, Clifton, New Jersey on
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the above Bonds of the School District dated December 15, 1996 and due (subject to prior redemption) on December 15 as follows:
$15,300,000 School Bonds maturing in the principal amount of
$425,000 in the year 1998, $450,000 in the year 1999, $525,000 in each
of the years 2000 and 2001, $775,000 in each of the years 2002 and
2003, $800,000 in the year 2004, $825,000 in the year 2005 and

$850,000 in each of the years 2006 to 2017, inclusive. The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Board in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Board will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon & Scotland, Newark, N.J. The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% (ascending rates and only one rate per maturity) specified by the successful bidder payable semiannually on June 15 and December 15 in each year until maturity, commencing on June 15, 1997. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale.
The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting Karen L. Perkins, the Board Secretary at 745 Clifton Avenue, Clifton, New Jersey 07015, (201) 470-2288.
